description.from:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a application developer, I want usable asset metadata and current published versions, so that applications can display articles reliably.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Deliver public asset references and published revisions consistently
  Scenario: Read article assets
    Given a published article has public images or other media
    When I fetch its JSON representation
    Then I receive usable public asset references with available type, dimensions, alt text, caption and credit
    And asset URL lifetime and refresh behavior are documented
    And no private storage paths, credentials or draft-only assets are disclosed
  Scenario: Refresh an application after publication changes
    Given my application previously read a published article
    When that article is revised or withdrawn
    Then article retrieval and lists converge on the same published state within the shared freshness bound
    And cache/version information allows documented client refresh behavior
```
